name: How can I make my bathroom more accessible or 'aging-in-place' friendly?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my bathroom more accessible or 'aging-in-place' friendly?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a bathroom more accessible, consider features like a curbless shower, grab bars, a comfort-height toilet, and wider doorways. Proper lighting and non-slip flooring are also crucial for safety. Planning for future needs during a remodel can save significant expense and disruption later. We can incorporate these design elements into your remodel, helping to create a bathroom that is safe and comfortable for all ages and abilities, enhancing your home's long-term liveability in the East Bay.
